تستأنسوا (form X)
# تَسْتَأْنِسُوا (tastaʔnisū) /tas.taʔ.ni.suː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْنَسَ (istaʔnasa)
# تُسْتَأْنَسُوا (tustaʔnasū) /tus.taʔ.na.suː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْنَسَ (istaʔnasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
